🆕 NEW RELEASE: Deryck Whibley reworks Sum 41 songs on solo album

Deryck Whibley has announced Diamonds Of The Night: Vol. 1, a solo album of twelve Sum 41 songs in slower "Diamond Version" arrangements. The first single, "With Me (First Dance Version)", came out on 18 Nov 2026 with a video. Whibley produced, engineered and mixed the record himself.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Palaye Royale announce Amsterdamage World Tour for 2027

Palaye Royale will tour Europe and the UK from early March into April 2027, with four German shows: two in Munich, one in Berlin and one in Cologne. The run follows their sixth album Amsterdamage, due on 22 Jan 2027, and its lead single "Lost In Translation".

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Stand Atlantic and Scene Queen announce Godbreath co-headline tour

Stand Atlantic and Scene Queen will co-headline the Godbreath Tour across the UK and Europe from 1 to 13 March 2027. The German stops are Berlin on 1 March and Cologne on 2 March.

🎟️ TOUR NEWS: Movements plan Happier Now tour with four German shows

California post-hardcore band Movements will tour Europe and the UK in February and March 2027 behind their album Happier Now, released in early September 2026. Gouge Away are the support act. German dates run from 26 Feb in Hamburg to 5 Mar in Berlin.

📣 JUST ANNOUNCED: Quicksand announce Bring On The Psychics tour in Europe

Quicksand will play the Bring On The Psychics Tour across Europe and the UK from 28 April to 27 May 2027. Seven German club shows are listed: Munich, Stuttgart, Frankfurt, Cologne, Hannover, Hamburg and Berlin.
